text:
marta: Hey team, auditor checking in — they want a single snapshot that ties the incident from 03/12 to the RBAC change we did on 03/11 and KMS key rotation proof. Can we assemble a minimal evidence bundle by EOD?

alex: we can. I have CloudTrail and GCS object metadata lined up, but need to prove the service-account deprov that coincided with the fix.

sam: @alex do you have the splunk query we used during triage? auditor asked for the filters and exact time window.

alex: yep — here's the query I ran (index=audit host=redwood-api) and the timeframe 2026-03-11T18:20:00Z to 2026-03-12T02:00:00Z:
```
index=audit host=redwood-api action=assume_role OR action=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy | stats count by user, src_ip, action, _time
```

marta: @auditor_jane they're asking for: control mapping (ISO), the RBAC change PR link, the session logs proving the deprov, and the KMS rotation manifest + key provenance. Is that the full list?

auditor_jane: yes that covers it. Prefer a single tarball with a small README mapping artifacts to control IDs (A.9.2 / SOC2 CC6 etc). Also need hashes for each file and an explanation of how we correlate logs to the change.

oncall: adding incident-runbook note: we performed a canary rollback at 18:35 and then forced service-account deprov at 18:50. The playbook entry is here: https://go/redwood/oncall/runbooks/deprov-service-account.

sam: for KMS: we rotated key alias redwood-prod-ml on 2026-03-10 22:00 UTC. Audit export includes KeyId, WrappedKeyMaterial (not included), and the KMS event ids. I'll pull the export.

alex: question — do auditors want encrypted exports or plaintext? For Chain-of-Custody we prefer signed+hashed manifests (sha256). We can encrypt the bundle with their public key if they'd like.

auditor_jane: signed+hashed manifest is fine. Encryption optional but preferred for sensitive logs. We'll provide a verification pubkey.

marta: plan:
- alex: collect splunk & CloudTrail extracts + timestamps, include query text
- sam: export KMS rotation log + key metadata (KeyId, rotationTimestamp, rotationEventID) and include a short note on why WrappedKeyMaterial not included
- oncall: capture the runbook timeline and link to deploy history/pr diff (PR #4021)
- me: assemble README mapping files to SOC2/ISO controls and create sha256sum.txt

oncall: PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/PRs/4021 — includes the RBAC change and test log snippets.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: canary rollback applied by @oncall at 2026-03-11T18:35:12Z (build b-9042).

alex: copying example of the manifest header we'll include:
```
manifest_version: 1
bundle_created: 2026-03-12T06:00:00Z
creator: alex@redwood.com
files:
  - splunk_audit_20260311-18_20260312-02.json
  - cloudtrail_api_20260311-18_20260312-02.json
  - kms_rotation_export_20260310.json
  - runbook_deprov.md
sha256sum: see sha256sum.txt
```

sam: note on KMS provenance: we can include a link to KMS audit events and a signed statement from cloud-kms-adm that confirms key material rotation time and KeyId. I'll request that now.

marta: auditor_jane — do you need any additional context (e.g., vuln tracker IDs) tied into the bundle? The vuln was triaged as CVE-2026-0123 and marked critical -> patched in PR #4021.

auditor_jane: include the vuln tracker entry, yes. We need the timeline showing discovery -> triage -> PR -> deploy -> deprov. A CSV timeline is ideal.

alex: I'll generate timeline.csv with columns: timestamp, actor, action, artifact_link. Will include references to PR #4021 and issue RED-1892.

oncall: one more: confirm retention/scrubbing: some logs contain PII and will be redacted. We need to document redaction steps in README and include sanitized vs raw storage locations.

marta: good catch. We'll include a redaction_manifest.txt listing patterns redacted and a pointer to the raw secure bucket (audit only) for the auditor if they request.

auditor_jane: that should be sufficient. Please share a presigned URL for the tarball when ready and paste the sha256 here. I'll ack receipt and start mapping to controls.

sam: working on KMS export now — ETA 90m.

alex: pulling splunk/CloudTrail bundles — ETA 45m.

marta: I'll start the README and mapping. Will ping when bundle is uploaded. :thumbsup:

auditor_jane: thanks, team. If anything changes ping me directly.
